items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: I was with Fuller then... Fuller on trumpet, and me on string bass.

ctx.x: Well, he had this big thing with Ed Fox. The Union got into it, law suits, what do you recall of that time? I presume he'd already broken up the band?
Yeah. Well, I was with Fuller then.
Fuller took the band into the Grand Terrace?
